verdict.rationale: The docs show documents being pushed into a collection and then searched, which implies incremental adds without a separate reindex step (typesense-docs-8, typesense-docs-35). Nothing in the pack covers updates, deletes, or how quickly changes become searchable. Missing for 10: documented update/upsert and delete APIs, explicit near-real-time visibility or latency guarantees for writes, statement that no full reindex is needed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
